description:
Look up a Spanish company by its NIF/CIF tax ID. Use it when the user gives
a tax ID (with a name use search_companies); on a hit, call
company_history with company_slug.

Returns JSON {found, company_slug, current_name, status, nif_source,
nif_caveat, ...}; use current_name. BORME has no dedicated tax-ID field: more
than 580,000 NIF mappings from public sources and the text of BORME notices
cover a minority of companies, so a miss (reason nif_unmapped) means
"not matched yet", not "does not exist". reason nif_revoked: AEAT records a
revocation; relay tell_the_user. On a company match, relay nif_status.note if
present. invalid_input true: not a NIF/CIF.
reason nif_check_character_failed: relay tell_the_user and did_you_mean.
reason not_registry_entity: explain entity_type. ambiguous
true: ask which candidate. nif_caveat present: say the link is not settled.

Read-only. Needs the basic plan or higher: send your
API key in the X-API-Key header (https://bormeapi.com/account).

nif.description: Spanish NIF/CIF, normally 9 characters, e.g. B12345674. Spaces, hyphens, dots and the ES VAT prefix (ESB12345674) are accepted; other country prefixes are not.
nif.title: Nif

title: Find a company by NIF
